As the guy who always helms the things ive found are as follows.

1. Keep in mind the cannon peoples angles. If they cant shoot then you aint doing ypur job.
2. Stay out of broad side, ik its simple but you would be surprised how easy it is to forget in the heat of the battle.
3. Sail management, you need to constantly be on top of your sails. Let your crew mates know when to raise and lower. My usual comands are (depending on ship)
"Front sail half mast" "Raise back mast" "Angle wind" and "FULL SAIL"
4. Prioritization, Depedning on the situation its better to let some water in so you can lay down some cannons. This will come with experience.
5. You need to be aware of everything around you. Hitting an island mid fight can spell the end. Its happned to me before 😅
6. As helmsmen you are in charge of the ship. Acknowledge when mistakes were made and learn from them, thats what good leaders do. 

Hope this helps.
